fields.description: ELO is DAMAC’s original one- and two-bedroom apartment development at DAMAC Hills 2. Its curved residential form and balconies face the surrounding parkland, with on-site swimming, fitness and family recreation alongside the wider community’s facilities.

overview: The brochure uses private balconies and park-facing layouts as the starting point for apartment design. A compact one-bedroom example combines an open kitchen and living area with a separate bedroom and balcony. Exact outlooks and room configurations vary by unit and should be checked against the approved plan.
research.locationNote: Original ELO is within DAMAC Hills 2, not the later Islands community. DAMAC identifies parklands and access to the wider master community; confirm the tower entrance and intended daily routes for the selected home.
research.priceNote: The branded factsheet starts one-bedroom homes at AED 547,000 and two-bedroom homes at AED 818,000. These original guides do not establish today’s availability or a final quotation.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder supplies the 20/60/20 aggregate stages shown below. The factsheet prints 70/30 and 80/20 alternatives, but their individual rows total 99% and 104% respectively despite 100% captions. These inconsistencies are retained as unresolved; no missing instalment or fee has been assumed.
research.handoverNote: DAMAC’s original page and the branded factsheet estimate December 2026. Confirm actual completion and the selected home’s contractual date.
